profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Modus21
profile.summary:
• Highly dedicated software solutions developer with a proven track record coding, designing, and architecting enterprise solutions.
• Stickler for principles of high quality object-oriented design such as patterns and good old fashioned loose coupling, tight cohesion, and information hiding.
• Huge fan of unit testing and agile methodologies.
• Loves solving challenging problems and the learning opportunities they present.
• Has fun developing high performance, multi-threaded Java applications.
• Self motivated and meticulous - a finisher as well as a starter.

Specialties: Effective OO with Java, SCJP 1.4 & 1.5, SCJD, Design Patterns, Spring, XML, JUnit, Tomcat, JBoss, WebLogic, SSL, PKI, Digital Signatures, JavaScript, jQuery, CSS, EJB, JPA, JMS, Web Services, REST, Eclipse, IntelliJ, Maven, Ant, Servlets, JSP, Oracle PL/SQL, SQL Server Transact SQL, PostgreSQL, MacOSX, Windows, *nix

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: North Charleston, South Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Leading a team building middleware to modernize a COBOL system for the US Navy.
Software is a Micronaut Java 25 project deployed to serverless AWS Lambdas.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.locationName: Charleston, South Carolina Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
Enjoyed working at a cutting edge tech company.  Some fun stuff I did include:
* Solved a database row locking contention issue due to out of order asynchronous messaging
* Gave training presentations on unit testing, and the organization's proprietary Java persistence framework
* Designed and developed a secure messaging microservice, based on Spring Boot with a React UI, deployed in a Docker container to AWS with Kubernetes
positions.insights: Skills: RESTful WebServices · REST APIs · Microservices · Spring Boot · React.js · Unit Testing · Scrum · Agile Methodologies · Oracle Database · WebLogic · Git · JUnit · Swagger API · Mockito · AssertJ · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Docker · Object Oriented Design · Java · JavaScript · jQuery · JSP · Technical Leadership · JSON · Maven · Jackson · PostgreSQL · Kubernetes

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Worked on exciting projects for the Office of Naval Research that fully utilized the JEE6 technology stack, kicked off adding automated unit tests to a Liferay application, and ported a legacy web application based on Apache Struts over to Spring Boot.
positions.insights: Skills: J2EE · JUnit · JBoss · EJB · Vaadin · Spring Boot · JMockit · Maven

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.locationName: Charleston, South Carolina Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description: Worked on several projects for the US Air Force, USTRANSCOM, and USMC.  They involved researching Drools rules engine for building a mission planning system, developing the front end and REST services for a shipping logistics system, and developing a touchscreen web application running in a JavaFX container for armored vehicles.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · JBoss · Drools · JUnit · JavaFX · VMWare ESXi

positions.title: Senior Java Developer and Team Lead
positions.locationName: Charleston, South Carolina Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description: I worked as a member of this information technology services company providing my software development expertise for a variety of clients such as the US Navy, the Naval Oceanographic Office, the Veterans Administration, and International-Matex Tank Terminal.  I've developed software primarily in Java utilizing various open source technologies, as well as other object-oriented programming languages, and some database and reporting development.  I'm a huge fan of JUnit and test driven development, design patterns, and agile methodologies.  My last project was implementing a Service Oriented Architecture, following the Agile Scrum methodology, and using continuous integration tools.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · J2EE · WebLogic · Oracle Database · Agile Methodologies · Scrum · JavaScript · jQuery · Design Patterns · Object Oriented Design · JUnit · Cobertura · Leading Development Teams · SOAP · XML · Jakarta XML Binding (JAXB) · SoapUI · JPA · Spring Framework

positions.title: Java Developer and Team Lead
positions.locationName: New Orleans, Louisiana, United States · On-site
positions.description: Contract OO developer for the US Navy's largest PeopleSoft implementation.  Started out utilizing the proprietary language SNAP, part of a workflow framework by Template/Level 8 software, then Java, for all of the backend communications and data replication infrastructure of the Navy's personnel system.  One of the lead designers and developers of the Navy's JMS system that securely replicates personnel data between ships and their central database ashore.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · JMS · PKI · SSL · SSL Certificates · TLS · Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTPS) · FIPS 140-2 · FIPS · Oracle Database · Java Concurrency · Concurrent Programming
